author: piztanza
description: Cross-device visual fixes from live-site screenshot review: hero floating cards become in-flow below 1024px (they currently overlap the scene and escape the hero on phone); missing PDF chip icon fixed; desktop fit-pill repositioned off the Authenticity label; price no-wrap in the part card; per-breakpoint hero H1 reserved height; tighter phone catalog stage; taller phone map aspect (~4:3 <640px).
acceptance_criteria: Below 1024px the hero's part card, fit pill, and video card render in-flow below the scene with no overlap of each other, the scene, the nav, or the following section; >=1024px keeps the floating overlay
All three file-type icons (XLS, PDF, JPG) visibly render in the AI catalog chips at every width
At >=1024px the 'Authenticity — Genuine' label is fully readable — the fit pill no longer covers any spec label
'Rp 385.000' stays on one line at every width with balanced spacing to the Verified-fit chip
Hero H1-to-subcopy gap looks intentional at 390/768/1024/1440 with zero rotation layout shift
Phone (<640px) AI catalog stage is compact with proportionally larger sprites — no large empty dark block; unify map uses ~4:3 aspect and remains draggable
No copy changes; reduced-motion behavior preserved; suite green with updated tests
